'''Jakanda''' is a town in [[Arafel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jakanda}}

Not much is known about this town other than there is a metal worker there. [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] has bells in her hair that were made in Jakanda.{{ref/book|10|p}}
